component.name: MA-TUI
component.summary: Terminal controller, local speaker and desktop media controls for Music Assistant

description.p: MA-TUI is a terminal interface for Music Assistant: browse your library and providers, control playback, volume, grouping and queues across your networked speakers, and follow podcasts and audiobooks with resume points and played-episode tracking. It also registers the machine it runs on as a Sendspin speaker, so Music Assistant can send audio there directly, without a separate companion player process.

Media keys and compatible desktop bars can show and control the selected player via MPRIS. Track notifications are optional and off by default. Browse recently played music, sort and filter your library, manage favourites and library items, start radio, and add music or the queue to playlists.

ul.li: Add MPRIS desktop media controls and optional track notifications.
Manage favourites and library items; browse recently played music and sort or filter the library.
Start radio, add items to playlists and save the queue as a playlist.

description.p: Automatic recovery from local audio output stream failures, with bounded retries that preserve volume, mute and delay. Persistent failures remain visible, and diagnostics show output format, callback health and recovery counts. Fix unplayed-podcast tracking to report incomplete results instead of a silently partial list, and to refresh on progress changes from other clients. Default local startup volume to 50 percent. Declare RTKit as an optional Arch dependency.
Show the real reason a local audio stream failed instead of a generic message. Draw a rule between the player list and the queue. Drop the stale "(Flatpak Beta)" label from the desktop entry name.
Security update (rustls TLS fix) and README corrections.
